releases.notes:
Bug-fix release for 1.1.0. **Requires:** Minecraft 26.3, Fabric Loader 0.19.5+, Fabric API, Voxy 0.2.20-beta, Sodium. Replace the old jar with `seedlod-1.1.1+26.3.jar`.

### Fixes
- **Complete structures:** End cities were missing rooms and mansions could lose parts. A room that spawns an entity (End city shulkers, elytra item frames) made the rest of the structure in that chunk get skipped. Each piece is now placed on its own. End cities and mansions now match vanilla block for block.
- **No structures cut off at the edge:** when any part of a structure is generated, the whole structure is, even past the generation radius.
- **Much faster mansions:** they could take over a minute to place before.
- **No more gap at the edge of the loaded area:** after a portal, or when flying fast, a ring of chunks around you could stay empty. Those chunks are now retried once you've moved on.

### Upgrading from 1.1.0
Structures generated by 1.1.0 can be incomplete. Run `/seedlod reset` once in each dimension to redraw them; real explored terrain is kept.

mods.name: SeedLOD for Voxy
mods.description: Fills Voxy's LODs straight from the world seed, at the resolution Voxy draws them.

releases.notes:
**Requires:** Minecraft 26.3, Fabric Loader 0.19.5+, Fabric API, Voxy 0.2.20-beta, Sodium. Client-side only. Replaces 1.0.0: drop `seedlod-1.1.0+26.3.jar` into your `mods` folder and remove the old jar.

### Structures
- The structures you can see from a distance now appear in the LODs: villages, desert and jungle temples, pillager outposts, woodland mansions, ocean ruins, ocean monuments, shipwrecks, ruined portals, igloos, witch huts, Nether fortresses, bastions and End cities.
- Placed with vanilla's own placement and building code, including the flattened ground under villages and bastions. Tested against vanilla generation: block counts match closely (End cities come out somewhat smaller).
- Works in singleplayer and on servers. Underground structures (strongholds, mineshafts, ancient cities, trial chambers) are left out.
- Turn off with `/seedlod config structures false`.

### Fair play for servers
Server owners decide: put a marker in your MOTD or send it in any chat or system message.
- `seedlod:no-structures`: terrain only, no structures.
- `seedlod:disable`: SeedLOD doesn't run on your server.

Clients wait for the MOTD after joining, remember the rule per server, and redraw when it changes. See the README for details.

### Fixes
- `/seedlod reset` now keeps real explored terrain and regenerates only what SeedLOD made. Before, it could skip chunks after a reset.
- Existing worlds: distant areas gain structures automatically; run `/seedlod reset` once for areas near where you've been.

mods.name: SeedLOD for Voxy
mods.description: Fills Voxy's LODs straight from the world seed, at the resolution Voxy draws them.

releases.notes:
First release of SeedLOD for Voxy: fills Voxy's LODs straight from the world seed, so distant terrain shows up without exploring it.

**Requires:** Minecraft 26.3, Fabric Loader 0.19.5+, Fabric API, Voxy 0.2.20-beta, Sodium. Client-side only.

**Install:** drop `seedlod-1.0.0+26.3.jar` into your `mods` folder next to Fabric API, Voxy and Sodium.

- **Singleplayer / LAN host:** uses the world's real generator, so datapacks and worldgen mods are included.
- **Servers:** rebuilds vanilla terrain from the seed. If you're allowed to run `/seed`, SeedLOD picks it up automatically; otherwise set it with `/seedlod seed <seed>`. Your seed is checked against the hash the server sends, so a wrong seed is refused. Servers with custom worldgen will look different.
- Near you it runs the full vanilla terrain pipeline; further out it samples terrain at the size of the LOD voxels Voxy draws, which is much faster.
- Never overwrites real terrain you've explored.

Commands: `/seedlod fill|stop|status|reset|seed|preset|config`. See the README for details.

Known limits: no structures, caves or ores; trees are simple approximations.
